title: PI process rule: copy hypotheses verbatim from agent reports
question: How to prevent the PI from dropping hypotheses when transcribing agent results into HYP records?
rationale: Twice in this session the PI transcription dropped a hypothesis that the agent report stated (HYP-5da6025e part (2): N <= (r−1)/2; HYP-dbe79a50 Corollary P1: N < char F); both were caught by blind adversarial review.
claims: HYP statements derived from agent reports must quote the hypotheses verbatim (or be checked line by line against the report) before registration; blind review remains mandatory.
